nodes.description: Public mapping(address => uint) balanceOf tracking token balances of every holder.
Public nested mapping(address => mapping(address => uint)) allowance storing spender approvals.
Private address owner, set to msg.sender in constructor, used as privileged guard in delegate and batchSend.
Public uint totalSupply of the ShikokuInu token, assigned from constructor argument.
Public payable transfer(address _to, uint _value) that delegates to transferFrom(msg.sender, _to, _value).
Public payable transferFrom guarded by the ensure modifier; performs unchecked balance/allowance arithmetic and emits Transfer.
Public payable approve(address _spender, uint _value) writing allowance[msg.sender][_spender] and emitting Approval.
Public payable delegate(address a, bytes b) that requires msg.sender == owner and then performs a low-level delegatecall to an arbitrary address.
Owner-only batchSend(address[] _tos, uint _value) computing total = _value * _tos.length and looping over recipients.
Modifier ensure(address _from, address _to) that derives the Uniswap pair via pairFor and restricts transfers to owner or the pair.
Internal pure pairFor computing the deterministic Uniswap V2 pair address from factory, tokenA and tokenB.
Payable constructor initializing name, symbol, totalSupply, owner and minting the entire supply to the deployer.
msg.sender is attacker-controllable and drives owner checks, allowance accounting and balance mutations.
Low-level a.delegatecall(b) executed in delegate context, allowing arbitrary code execution in the token's storage.
Unchecked arithmetic in batchSend: total = _value * _tos.length and balanceOf[msg.sender] -= total can overflow/underflow.
Unchecked arithmetic in transferFrom: allowance/_from subtraction and balanceOf[_from] -= _value, balanceOf[_to] += _value.
Parameter _to of transfer, forwarded as recipient.
Parameter _value of transfer, forwarded as transferred amount.
Parameter _from of transferFrom, the debited account checked by the ensure modifier.
Parameter _to of transferFrom, the credited account.
Parameter _value of transferFrom, amount moved between balances.
Parameter _spender of approve, address receiving the allowance.
Parameter _value of approve, the allowance amount granted.
Parameter a of delegate, arbitrary target address of the delegatecall.
Parameter b of delegate, attacker-supplied calldata executed via delegatecall.
Parameter _tos of batchSend, the array of recipient addresses.
Parameter _value of batchSend, per-recipient amount multiplied by array length.
Constructor parameter _name assigned to the name state variable.
Constructor parameter _symbol assigned to the symbol state variable.
Constructor parameter _supply assigned to totalSupply and minted to the deployer.
Local variable total = _value * _tos.length in batchSend, used for the balance precondition.
Local loop variable _to in batchSend, each recipient pulled from _tos.
Loop counter i in batchSend iterating over the _tos array.
Local variable UNI in the ensure modifier, the computed Uniswap pair address allowed to transfer.

edges.reason: transfer forwards its _to parameter into the transferFrom call.
transfer forwards its _value parameter into the transferFrom call.
transferFrom _from parameter is used for allowance and balance accounting.
transferFrom _to parameter is used as the credited account.
transferFrom _value parameter flows into unchecked subtraction and addition of balances.
approve _spender parameter indexes the allowance mapping.
approve _value parameter is stored as the allowance amount.
delegate parameter a is the target address of the delegatecall.
delegate parameter b is the calldata executed by the delegatecall.
batchSend _tos array supplies recipients and its length to the total computation.
batchSend _value parameter is multiplied by _tos.length without overflow protection.
constructor stores its _name parameter into the name state variable.
constructor stores its _symbol parameter into the symbol state variable.
constructor assigns _supply to totalSupply and to the deployer balance.
transfer uses msg.sender as the source of the delegated transferFrom call.
transferFrom branches on whether msg.sender differs from _from to decide allowance deduction.
approve writes the allowance entry keyed by msg.sender.
delegate gates execution on require(msg.sender == owner) before performing the delegatecall.
batchSend gates execution on require(msg.sender == owner) before mass balance mutations.
constructor sets owner and the initial balance to the untrusted msg.sender.
transfer unconditionally routes execution into transferFrom.
transferFrom executes under the ensure modifier which restricts _from or _to to owner or the Uniswap pair.
ensure calls pairFor to derive the UNI pair address used in its require.
transferFrom mutates the balanceOf mapping for both source and destination.
transferFrom decrements the allowance mapping when the caller is not the source.
approve writes directly into the allowance mapping.
batchSend decrements the sender balance and increments each recipient balance.
delegate performs the low-level delegatecall after passing the owner check.
batchSend performs unchecked multiplication and subtraction that can overflow or underflow.
transferFrom performs unchecked balance and allowance arithmetic without SafeMath.
delegate reads the owner state variable as its authorization condition.
batchSend reads the owner state variable as its authorization condition.
constructor initializes the owner state variable.
constructor initializes totalSupply from the supplied amount.
batchSend computes the local total from _value and _tos.length.
the local total feeds the unchecked multiplication/subtraction vulnerable arithmetic.
batchSend iterates _tos and copies each entry into the local _to variable.
batchSend loop bound and increment are driven by the local counter i.
the local UNI pair address computed in ensure is compared against _from.

normalization_plan.reason: Function argument _to of transfer only exists to be forwarded into transferFrom and can be folded into the transfer node.
Function argument _value of transfer only exists to be forwarded into transferFrom and can be folded into the transfer node.
Argument _from of transferFrom is a per-call operand of the transfer logic and merges into the function node.
Argument _to of transferFrom is a per-call operand of the transfer logic and merges into the function node.
Argument _value directly drives the unchecked balance arithmetic in transferFrom.
Argument _spender of approve is a call-local operand of the approval logic.
Argument _value of approve is a call-local operand of the approval logic.
Argument a of delegate is the target address supplied to the dangerous delegatecall.
Argument b of delegate is the calldata supplied to the dangerous delegatecall.
Argument _tos of batchSend is a call-local recipient list used by the batch loop.
Argument _value of batchSend is multiplied by array length in the unchecked arithmetic.
Constructor argument _name is a deployment-local value assigned to a state variable.
Constructor argument _symbol is a deployment-local value assigned to a state variable.
Constructor argument _supply is a deployment-local value assigned to totalSupply.
Local total holds the result of the unchecked multiplication and precondition of the batch transfer.
Local loop variable _to is a transient copy of an element of _tos inside batchSend.
Local loop index i is a transient control variable entirely contained in batchSend.
Local UNI is a transient computed pair address used only inside the ensure modifier.
